title: Add an in-stock book to cart
actual: ✔ POST /cart/items returned 200; ✔ cart has 1 line, quantity 1

title: Reject out-of-stock book
actual: ✔ returned 409 OUT_OF_STOCK; ✔ cart has 0 lines afterwards

title: Cart requires authentication
actual: ✔ returned 401 UNAUTHORIZED; ✔ tampered token on GET /cart returned 401

title: Update item quantity
actual: ✔ PATCH returned 200; ✔ quantity is 3; ✔ total is 300

title: Quantity boundaries rejected
actual: ✔ quantity 0 returned 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; ✔ quantity -1 returned 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; ✔ quantity 6 returned 409 OUT_OF_STOCK; ✔ quantity 5 returned 200

title: Remove an item
expected: Only the other item remains; total recalculated
actual: ✔ DELETE returned 200; ✔ 1 line left; ✔ total is 25

title: Cart total equals sum of price x quantity
actual: ✔ total is 1248.50

title: Empty cart total is zero
actual: ✔ status 200, total 0.00, 0 lines

title: Disabled book in the cart is flagged, left out of the total and blocks checkout (new in Part 3)
expected: Line available=false, total excludes it; POST /orders gives 409 OUT_OF_STOCK; no order
actual: ✔ book disabled (200); ✔ disabled line available=false; ✔ total is 100.00 (disabled book excluded); ✔ checkout returned 409 OUT_OF_STOCK; ✔ orders before 0, after 0

title: Reject checkout with empty cart
actual: ✔ returned 422 CART_EMPTY; ✔ orders before 0, after 0

title: Reject checkout with missing shipping address
actual: ✔ address "" returned 422 VALIDATION_ERROR field=shippingAddress; ✔ address "   " returned 422 VALIDATION_ERROR field=shippingAddress; ✔ address undefined returned 422 VALIDATION_ERROR field=shippingAddress; ✔ stock unchanged (5)

title: Shipping address length boundary
actual: ✔ 301 characters returned 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; ✔ 300 characters returned 201

title: Successful checkout creates order
expected: 201; PLACED, SUCCESS, orderNumber present; stock reduced; cart emptied
actual: ✔ returned 201; ✔ status PLACED, payment SUCCESS; ✔ orderNumber ORD-20261117-A50B59F6; ✔ total 998.00; ✔ stock is 3 (5 - 2); ✔ cart emptied

title: Order numbers are unique
Item sold out between cart and checkout
expected: 409 OUT_OF_STOCK; no order for the late customer
actual: ✔ first customer returned 201; ✔ second customer returned 409 OUT_OF_STOCK; ✔ second customer's orders before 4, after 4; ✔ stock is 0

title: Concurrent checkout of last copy (10 rounds)
expected: Exactly one order succeeds, the other gets 409; stock never negative
actual: ✔ 10/10 rounds gave one 201 and one 409 with stock 0 (201/409 stock 0 | 201/409 stock 0 | 201/409 stock 0 | 201/409 stock 0 | 201/409 stock 0 | 201/409 stock 0 | 201/409 stock 0 | 201/409 stock 0 | 201/409 stock 0 | 201/409 stock 0)

title: Book create, edit, restock and disable need a staff login (DEF-04 regression)
expected: No token 401, customer token 403, staff token succeeds; reads stay public
actual: ✔ POST /api/books with no token returned 401; ✔ POST /api/books as CUSTOMER returned 403; ✔ PUT /api/books/:id with no token returned 401; ✔ PUT /api/books/:id as CUSTOMER returned 403; ✔ PATCH /api/books/:id/stock with no token returned 401; ✔ PATCH /api/books/:id/stock as CUSTOMER returned 403; ✔ PATCH /api/books/:id/disable with no token returned 401; ✔ PATCH /api/books/:id/disable as CUSTOMER returned 403; ✔ stock unchanged at 3 after the refused calls; ✔ PATCH stock as ADMIN_STAFF returned 200; ✔ GET /api/books without a token still returns 200

title: Staff accounts cannot use the cart or orders (new in Part 3)
actual: ✔ GET /api/v1/cart as ADMIN_STAFF returned 403 FORBIDDEN; ✔ GET /api/v1/orders as ADMIN_STAFF returned 403 FORBIDDEN; ✔ POST /api/v1/orders as ADMIN_STAFF returned 403 FORBIDDEN

title: Idempotency-Key must be a UUID (new in Part 3)
expected: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR for missing or malformed key; no order
actual: ✔ key undefined returned 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; ✔ key "abc" returned 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; ✔ key "1234" returned 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; ✔ stock unchanged

title: Tampered total in the request body is ignored (new in Part 3)
expected: Order total is computed by the server
actual: ✔ returned 201, total 400.00 (cart total 400.00)

title: Customer with no orders sees empty history
actual: ✔ returned 200, 0 orders

title: Order history requires authentication
actual: ✔ GET /api/v1/orders returned 401 UNAUTHORIZED; ✔ GET /api/v1/orders/000000000000000000000000 returned 401 UNAUTHORIZED; ✔ PATCH /api/v1/orders/000000000000000000000000/cancel returned 401 UNAUTHORIZED

title: Order history lists own orders, newest first, with status (API)
expected: Own 3 orders, newest first, each with status
actual: ✔ 3 orders returned; ✔ newest first; ✔ each has a status and number; ✔ another customer's list does not contain them

title: View single order detail
expected: 200; items, total, status and statusHistory shown
actual: ✔ returned 200; ✔ items 1, total 30.00; ✔ status PLACED; ✔ statusHistory ["PLACED"]

title: Customer cannot read another customer's order
actual: ✔ detail returned 404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND; ✔ response has no order data; ✔ cancel returned 404; ✔ owner still sees PLACED; ✔ malformed id returned 404

title: Customer cancels own PLACED order
actual: ✔ stock after order 3; ✔ returned 200 CANCELLED; ✔ stock after cancel 5; ✔ history PLACED>CANCELLED

title: Customer cannot cancel after PROCESSING
expected: 409; status unchanged (code is INVALID_ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITION since the Sprint 2 state machine)
actual: ✔ staff moved it to PROCESSING (200); ✔ cancel returned 409 INVALID_ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITION; ✔ status still PROCESSING; ✔ stock not restored (4)

title: Cancelling twice restores stock once (new in Part 3)
expected: Second cancel 409; stock back to original exactly once
actual: ✔ first cancel 200; ✔ second cancel 409 INVALID_ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITION; ✔ stock 5 (not 7)

title: Two cancels at the same moment restore stock once, 10 rounds (new in Part 3)
expected: One 200 and one 409 per round; stock restored once

title: Status machine blocks invalid staff transitions (new in Part 3)
expected: PLACED to DELIVERED and CANCELLED to PROCESSING give 409; PLACED to PROCESSING to SHIPPED to DELIVERED works
actual: ✔ PLACED -> DELIVERED returned 409 INVALID_ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITION; ✔ PROCESSING/SHIPPED/DELIVERED returned 200/200/200; ✔ DELIVERED -> PROCESSING returned 409; ✔ customer token on admin route returned 403
